intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh. This page compares recorded fees, placements and NIRF ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.
NIET vs Sharda University is a same-city private comparison. NIET has the newer NIRF Engineering rank on this page, from 2025 at 101. Sharda's latest NIRF Engineering row here is from 2022, at 164.

sections.heading: NIET vs Sharda University for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose NIET if a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank matters most. NIET is listed at 101 in that year. Sharda's latest Engineering rank in our records is 164 from 2022.

Choose Sharda University if you want the more recent usable placement year on this page. Sharda has 2022 figures here, while NIET's latest recorded placement year is 2019, which we do not treat as current.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: NIET's raw fee rows include an exam fee of ₹11,500 and other charges as well as tuition of about ₹1.18 lakh a year. The exam fee is not the programme tuition and should not be read as the B.Tech cost.

Sharda University has recorded year-wise totals from about ₹1.69 lakh to ₹1.84 lakh and higher, depending on the programme. Confirm both official fee notices, because private university tuition changes by branch and year.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Sharda University's recorded 2022 figures are an average package of ₹6 lakh and a highest package of ₹40 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
NIET's latest recorded row here is from 2019, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹11 lakh. Because 2019 is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result.
Ask NIET for its latest official placement report before you compare the two sides on salary.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both institutes list JEE Main on this page. Sharda also runs its own admission process for many programmes.
Class 12 PCM is the usual academic requirement. Read the current official admissions page of each institute for tests, scholarships and lateral entry.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Greater Noida, in the Gautam Buddha Nagar area of Uttar Pradesh. The city is the same; the university type and the rank year are not.
Visit both if hostel, commute from Delhi NCR and lab facilities will decide the choice for you.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank, NIET at 101 is the newer listed side on this page.
If you want a post-2020 placement record here, Sharda University is the side with 2022 figures, at an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹40 lakh.
Do not use NIET's ₹11,500 exam-fee row as the programme cost. Check each official fee circular for the branch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, NIET or Sharda University, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: NIET has the newer NIRF Engineering rank, at 101 in 2025, against Sharda's 2022 rank of 164. Sharda has the more recent placement record on this page, from 2022. NIET's latest recorded placement year here is 2019.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for NIET vs Sharda University?
faqs.answer: NIET's recorded tuition is about ₹1.18 lakh a year; an exam fee of ₹11,500 in the raw rows is not the programme tuition. Sharda's recorded year-wise totals are about ₹1.69 lakh to ₹1.84 lakh, depending on the programme. Confirm official circulars.

faqs.question: Do NIET and Sharda University both accept JEE Main?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both list JEE Main on this page. Sharda may also use its own admission test or process. Check the current official admissions pages.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for NIET and Sharda University?
faqs.answer: Sharda's recorded 2022 average is ₹6 lakh and the highest is ₹40 lakh. NIET's latest recorded year here is 2019, which this page does not treat as a current flagship result.

faqs.question: Are NIET and Sharda University in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The comparison is about rank year, fees and placement records, not a change of city.
